changes: Add a compliant ReleaseFast TechEmpower JSON and plaintext benchmark application.
Compile eligible static response heads and retain bounded direct sends across ready pipelined requests.
Reuse keep-alive timeout operations and split request-body capabilities from response-only applications.
Reset request-head decoders in place while securely wiping only consumed bytes.
migration: No migration is required; documented 0.1.0 source API and observable behavior are preserved.
security: No known security correction applies to this release.
performance: Response-path work is reduced while fixed startup allocation, parser validation, secure clearing, response ordering, and backpressure contracts remain unchanged.
